versions.content: Service Name So Ad_ Write Dhcp Host Name Option Syntax Std_ Return Type So Ad_ Write Dhcp Host Name Option ( So Ad_ So Con Id Type So Con Id, uint8 length, const uint8* data ) Service ID [hex] 0x1B Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different So Con Ids. Non reentrant for the same So Con Id. Parameters (in) So Con Id socket connection index specifying the socket connection for which the hostname shall be changed length Length of hostname to be set. data Pointer to memory containing the hostname, i.e. the Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) according to IETF RFC 4702/ IETF RFC 4704. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ - Return - Type E_ OK: The request has been accepted E_ NOT_ OK: The request has not been accepted Description By this API service an upper layer of the So Ad can set the hostname, i.e. FQDN option in the DHCP submodule of the TCP/ IP stack. Available via So Ad.h
